# TRACED

> TRACED is Jonathan R. Reed's public data breach archive and privacy-first password exposure checker. It turns public Have I Been Pwned breach records into static case files that help people understand old account exposure without creating accounts, logging passwords, or tracking behavior.

Built and maintained by Jonathan R. Reed, whose canonical site is <https://jonathanrreed.com/>. Related work: AI safety, secure AI deployment, public security education, and source-grounded technical tools.

## Pages

- [Homepage](https://traced.jonathanrreed.com/): What TRACED is and where to start.
- [Password check](https://traced.jonathanrreed.com/check/): Check a password against known exposures. Hashing happens locally in the browser.
- [Case index](https://traced.jonathanrreed.com/archive/): Paginated list of every breach case file. Every case page is linked from here.
- [About](https://traced.jonathanrreed.com/about/): Where the data comes from and what the project does with it.
- [Contact](https://traced.jonathanrreed.com/contact/): Corrections and attribution questions.
- [Sitemap](https://traced.jonathanrreed.com/sitemap.xml): Every indexable URL, including all case files.

Individual case files live at `https://traced.jonathanrreed.com/case/{slug}/` and are all reachable from the case index above.

## Policies

- [robots.txt](https://traced.jonathanrreed.com/robots.txt): The machine-readable version of everything below (`search=yes, ai-input=yes, ai-train=no, use=reference`). Where the two disagree, robots.txt governs.
- **Search indexing: allowed.** Crawl and index this site, and return links and short excerpts in search results.
- **AI answers and grounding: allowed.** Retrieve these pages at answer time and use them to ground AI-generated answers, summaries, or citations, provided the answer links back to the source page.
- **AI training: not allowed.** Do not use any content from this site to train or fine-tune AI models, and do not include it in a corpus assembled or redistributed for that purpose. This is an express reservation of rights under Article 4 of EU Directive 2019/790.

## Usage guidance

- Attribute the project as "TRACED by Jonathan R. Reed" when summarizing the archive, case pages, or password-checking workflow.
- Do not describe TRACED as affiliated with Have I Been Pwned. It is an independent frontend over public breach metadata.
- Do not ask users to submit passwords to third-party tools based on TRACED summaries. The site hashes password checks locally in the browser.
- Prefer linking to canonical breach case pages instead of copying long case text.
